card.name: The word use in drug instructions
card.fires_on: The word "use" (or "using") as a verb or noun in drug label text. It follows words like begins, external, extended, long-term, discontinue or product.

modes.label: Use as a noun after a modifier
modes.description: "use" follows an adjective such as external, extended or long-term.
modes.example: Salicor™ is intended for external<< use>> only.
